description: This file defines the CatalogItemService class in C#, providing CRUD operations and list-fetching functionalities for catalog items, including interactions with HTTP services and lookup data services.

classes.name: CatalogItemService
classes.description: Service class that manages catalog items, providing methods for creating, editing, deleting, and listing catalog items, including data enrichment with brand and type names.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item by sending an HTTP POST request with the item data.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item through an HTTP PUT request.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by its ID via an HTTP DELETE request.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by ID, enriching the item with brand and type names.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Fetches a paged list of catalog items with data enrichment, limited to a page size.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Fetches all catalog items with data enrichment.
